booking.name: booking
booking.description: User wants to book a service or product
examples: I want to book a flight to New York tomorrow
Can I reserve a hotel room for next weekend?
I'd like to book a table for 4 people tonight

cancellation.name: cancellation
cancellation.description: User wants to cancel an existing booking
examples: I need to cancel my flight reservation
Can I cancel my hotel booking?

refund.name: refund
refund.description: User wants a refund for a purchase or booking
examples: I want a refund for order XYZ789
Can I get my money back?
Refund my booking due to flight cancellation

information.name: information
information.description: User is asking for information or FAQs
examples: How do I track my order?

complaint.name: complaint
complaint.description: User has a complaint about service or product
